title: Sheep Herder
start: Speak to Councillor Halgrive outside of the East Ardougne church, north of the zoo.

rewards.t: 3100 coins (reimbursement for plague set, and 3000 coins as reward)

steps.t: Talk to Councillor Halgrive south of the Ardougne church and north of the zoo. [Chat: 1 What's wrong? › Accept]
Talk to Doctor Orbon inside the church and buy a pair of clothes for 100 coins. [Chat: 2 Talk about something else. › 2 Ok, I'll take it.]
Return to the lodestone and go west until you reach the fenced enclosure with a stone building and incinerator (looks like a furnace). It is south of the fishing guild.
Equip the plague jacket and trousers and enter the gate.
Pick up the cattleprod inside the stone enclosure, equip it.
Prod 1 of each colour sheep in and through the incinerator pen's gate. If the sheep are stuck, simply switch worlds.
p: A player prodding a sick sheep

steps.t: Enter the pen and use the sheep feed on each of them.
Take all 4 bones, then use them on the incinerator.
